_comment: OFFLINE-SHADER-VARIANT-BUILD-1 pilot manifest. Each pilot is a shader PROGRAM (a set of stages compiled together at runtime) and its enumerated variants (define-sets from shader-permutation-inventory.json). build_variants.py compiles each (pilot, variant, stage) to a deployable .spv + sidecar; check-spirv-artifacts.py verifies them. Start tiny: the postprocess composite pass (no variant macros, no UBO/SSBO blocks, location-based samplers, last-pass isolation).

pilots.note: composite/present pass: shaders/postprocess.{vert,frag} bound with kShaderPrefix (#version 430, no macros). gos_postprocess.cpp:457-461.

MechOpaque (PipelineId::MechOpaque): shaders/mech.{vert,frag} bound in gos_mech_batcher.cpp:552. Both variant macros are DEFAULT-ON, so stock runtime selects the both-on variant. shadow_mech is a SEPARATE program and stays GLSL. All 4 combos baked to cover kill-switch states.
